Alger, 17 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 17, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — LG Electronics won the highest distinction of "Best Brand of IFA 2026" at the IFA Innovation Awards. The South Korean manufacturer also secured several category awards for its televisions and audio equipment.
Pluie de récompenses pour les innovation: A shower of awards for LG's audiovisual innovations
Le groupe sud-coréen a décroché la premi: The South Korean group captured first place at the second edition of the IFA Innovation Awards. This prize recognizes the manufacturer's achievements in technological innovation and design.
Dans la catégorie audiovisuelle, le modè: In the audiovisual category, the LG OLED evo AI W6 model received the title of "Best in Home & Entertainment". This Wallpaper television combines a thickness of about nine millimeters, True Wireless transmission, and Hyper Radiant Color technology.
Le secteur audio a couronné le système L: The audio sector crowned the LG Sound Suite AI system with the "Best in Audio" award. This setup integrates the Dolby Atmos FlexConnect ecosystem to adapt speaker placement according to spaces.
Cinq titres honorifiques supplémentaires: Five additional honorary titles reward the LG OLED evo G6, Micro RGB evo (MRGB96), and Mini RGB evo (MRGB88) televisions. The StanbyME 2 Max multimedia solutions and the LG xboom Stage 501 speaker also figure among the acclaimed products.
